name: tpm-absent
title: Boot with no TPM: the fallback must be predictable
description: RETIRED 2026-08-01: superseded by the tpmq-1 authority (qualification/tpm/), whose no-tpm-cold cell is the paired control for every TPM cell; the ISQ-20260801-tpm-absent-* records remain valid for what they measured. Original intent: identical to first-boot except that the absence of a TPM is the point — the system must boot cleanly, no unit may fail for want of one, and nothing may hang waiting for a device that is not there.
